fullPassage: According to educational psychologist Susan Engel, curiosity begins to decrease as young as four years old. By the time we are adults, we have fewer questions and more default settings. As Henry James put it, "Disinterested curiosity is past, the mental grooves and channels set." The decline in curiosity can be traced in the development of the brain through childhood. Though smaller than the adult brain, the infant brain contains millions more neural connections. The wiring, however, is a mess; the lines of communication between infant neurons are far less efficient than between those in the adult brain. The baby's perception of the world is consequently both intensely rich and wildly disordered. As children absorb more evidence from the world around them, certain possibilities become much more likely and more useful and harden into knowledge or beliefs. The neural pathways that enable those beliefs become faster and more automatic, while the ones that the child doesn't use regularly are pruned away.

questions.passage: According to educational psychologist Susan Engel, curiosity begins to decrease as young as four years old. By the time we are adults, we have fewer questions and more default settings. As Henry James put it, "Disinterested curiosity is past, the mental grooves and channels set." The decline in curiosity can be traced in the development of the brain through childhood. Though smaller than the adult brain, the infant brain contains millions more neural connections. The wiring, however, is a mess; the lines of communication between infant neurons are far less efficient than between those in the adult brain. The baby's perception of the world is consequently both intensely rich and wildly disordered. As children absorb more evidence from the world around them, certain possibilities become much more likely and more useful and harden into knowledge or beliefs. The neural pathways that enable those beliefs become faster and more automatic, while <u>the ones</u> that the child doesn't use regularly are pruned away.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 the ones이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ the ones = 앞의 the neural pathways(신경 경로들)
det.analysis:
❌ ① 새로운 증거들: the ones는 증거가 아닌 신경 경로를 가리킴
❌ ② 더 많은 질문들: 마지막 문장의 신경 경로와 무관
✅ ③ 신경 경로들: 'The neural pathways ... become faster ..., while the ones that the child doesn't use regularly are pruned away'에서 the ones는 앞의 neural pathways를 받아 '자주 쓰지 않는 경로들'을 가리킴 ←정답
❌ ④ 지식과 믿음들: the ones는 지식·믿음이 아닌 신경 경로
det.tip: the neural pathways ... the ones = (안 쓰는) 신경 경로들
